## What changes, and why

## How it was checked

- [ ] `npm run build`, `npm run lint` and `npm test` pass
- [ ] `npm run docs:api:check` passes (API.md is generated: run `npm run docs:api` after a change to a prop)
- [ ] A change to focus, `inert`, layout or animation was checked in the browsers (`npm run test:browser`, and Firefox and WebKit)
- [ ] `npm run build:lib`, `npm run pack:check`, `npm run test:consumer`, `npm run test:next` and `npm run test:eject` pass when the package changed
- [ ] Commits follow Conventional Commits, in English, in one short line

[CONTRIBUTING.md](../blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) has the rest.
